mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment (s_no, s_delivery, s_d_no, s_status, o_no, m_no) VALUES (shipment_seq.NEXTVAL, #{s_delivery}, #{s_d_no}, #{s_status}, #{o_no}, #{m_no})
mapper.select: SELECT s_no, s_delivery, s_d_no, s_status, o_no, m_no FROM shipment WHERE m_no = #{m_no} ORDER BY s_no DESC
